findings.reason: The Definition appears to make the fingerprint state conditional on positive relative distance, while thm-qa-35-code-fingerprint-state-properties claims it for every binary code. Define the state for every positive-length code/map and reserve positive distance for correctness guarantees; clarify the distance convention for duplicate codewords.

The Definition allows arbitrary finite X,Y and promises in X×Y, but cites def-promise-problem, whose universe is binary strings. Clarify that this is a finite-relation generalization or specify the pair encoding.
Step 1.1 uses nonnegativity of child entropies without establishing it. Add the finite argument that each −p_i ln p_i is nonnegative for 0≤p_i≤1.
Step 2.1 uses a union bound over bad input pairs without citing or proving it. Supply the finite union-bound argument, for example by bounding the union indicator by the sum of event indicators.

The Statement and proof use tensor products of operators without the tensor-map definition in deps; Step 2.1 also assumes the tensor adjoint rule when identifying the diagonal of (Δ⊗τ)*(Δ⊗τ). Add/use the tensor-map supplier and show that the real diagonal entries on the product eigenbasis make Δ⊗τ self-adjoint before taking its square.

The algorithm item has ## Statement instead of ## Definition. Its repetition count r is neither an input nor fixed, and the loop and output bit are not fully specified. Give admissible inputs and outputs and an exact bounded loop; the correctness theorem can supply r.

Step 2.1 treats P+^⊗r as a projective-measurement effect and factors its tensor-product trace, but F9 only defines the one-test effects. Prove the product measurement and tensor-map multiplication/factorization locally or cite their exact suppliers.
